lines.en: I walk in front with a hand on my sword.
My steps aren't fast, but they're steady.

lines.zh: 我走过石板路，声音很轻。
lines.en: I cross the flagstones quietly.
I look back at you.
I take the path around.
I shift my sword behind me.
I reach the fork and stop.
I plant each step firmly.

lines.zh: 我抬手往下压，让你慢些。
lines.en: I push my palm down, telling you to slow.
I walk a stretch along the river.
I slow down to wait for you.
I head up that path.
I wait for you to catch up.
I rest my sword on my shoulder.
My sword stands taller than I do.
I'm weighing whether to go.
I touch the hilt.
This sword of mine is taller than I am.
I sit down for a while.
There's an old mark on my scabbard.
I listen to the water a while.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看天色，还早。
lines.en: I glance at the sky; still early.
I straighten my scabbard.

lines.zh: 我把剑抽出来又插回去。
lines.en: I draw the blade and sheathe it again.
I scrape the mud off my boots.
I straighten up.

lines.zh: 我把剑鞘敲了两下，等你。
lines.en: I tap the scabbard twice and wait.

lines.zh: 我松开剑柄，呼出一口气。
lines.en: I loosen my grip and let out a breath.
You came — I was waiting.
The sword is still sheathed and you're here.
Can you keep pace with me?

lines.zh: 站到我侧面来，背后我看不见。
lines.en: Stand at my side; I can't see behind.
I size you up.
Don't put your hand on a hilt.
I'm not a talkative one.
You've found your footing, I see.
There's no need for formality between us.
Would you walk with me?
I'll keep that face in mind.
Your sleeve is torn and the blood still wet.
You speak first; I'm listening.

lines.zh: 这条路我守着，你过去吧。
lines.en: I'll hold this road; go on through.
Don't go far from me.
I look up, my sword within reach.
You stand steadier than before.
I like the look of you.
Your footsteps are too scattered.
Then we walk together.
I give ground one step to the side.

lines.zh: 我压住伤口，血从指缝渗出。
lines.en: I clamp the wound; blood seeps between my fingers.
I grit my teeth and straighten up.

lines.zh: 我把血在袖口上擦掉了。
lines.en: I wipe the blood off on my sleeve.
I bring the blade across my body.
I shift my feet and steady myself.
My sword is still at hand.
I've read its technique.
Don't worry; this much is nothing.
I'm still on my feet, and can still fight.
That doesn't interest me.

lines.zh: 收回去，我的剑不吃这个。
lines.en: Put it away; my sword doesn't eat.

lines.zh: 我摆摆手，把东西推回去。
lines.en: I wave it off and push it back.
That won't move me.
Leave it there; I won't reach for it.
I'm not wanting anything.
I glance at it and keep my hands down.
You're a smooth one, aren't you?
I'll take it, and that's all.
No need to bring anything next time.
I stow it in my pack.
I'll find a use for this.
Thank yourself, not me.
Take from you and I owe you.
Let's keep going forward.
I appreciate the thought.
I'm not promising anything.
Steady; don't lean back.
You crash into me; my shoulder doesn't move.
I reach out and steady your arm.
I shift half a step and let you pass.
My scabbard knocked you.
You came away unmarked.
I carry some weight.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的靴子了，獭师父的剑还没出鞘。
lines.en: You stepped on my boot; Rakko's sword is still sheathed.
Step away; don't press against me.

lines.zh: 我一手扶着剑，走在队伍前面。
lines.en: Hand on my sword, I walk at the front.
I stopped thinking about that long ago.
I've always traveled alone.
There was a companion once.
He didn't make it to the end.
This sword is enough for me.
I don't want to burden anyone again.
If you want, follow along.
No need for those words.
You seem reliable enough.
Then we walk together.
I lift it one-handed.
This can come with us.

lines.zh: 我背上这把剑，是我自己的。
lines.en: The sword on my back is my own.
I do not show this sword casually.
Too heavy; put it back.
I look it over; it's good work.

lines.zh: 我翻过手，把它递到你面前。
lines.en: I turn my hand and offer it to you.

lines.zh: 獭师父的剑，不用来捡东西。
lines.en: Rakko's sword is not for picking things up.
I put it in my pack.
I won't bend; pick it up yourself.
There's someone on the road ahead.
I put my hand on the hilt.
I step in front of you.
I count one only.
I've read its movement.
I tighten my grip on the hilt.
Get behind me.

lines.zh: 它背对着我，剑还没出鞘。
lines.en: Its back is to me; my blade stays sheathed.
I'll speak first, then strike.
It struck first.
Rakko's sword comes from the side.
My blade rides low.
It's turning to find us.
I wait for it to raise its hand.
This step must be quick.
I move along the wall.
Its back is showing.
I lighten my step.

lines.zh: 它一回头，我的手按在剑上。
lines.en: It looks back; my hand settles on the hilt.
I stop in my tracks.
I draw and cut.
The cut runs shoulder to waist.
It's driven back several steps.
I sheathe and step back.
I block with the scabbard.
I clipped its hand.
That cut found nothing.

lines.zh: 我顺着剑势又压了上去。
lines.en: I follow the blade's momentum and press in.
My breathing is still steady.
Blood runs from its arm.
I come down that road.
The sword is in my hand.
I take in the surroundings.
This place is quiet enough.
I stop at the crossing.
I sheathe my blade.

lines.zh: 獭师父的剑，挂在我腰上。
lines.en: Master Rakko's sword hangs at my waist.
I straighten my collar, then speak.
I square the scabbard and head in.
The sun sits low.
Fire caught my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我从崖上摔下，落地翻了半圈。
lines.en: I fall from the ledge and roll half a turn.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我硬撑着往上。
lines.en: Water fills my throat and I force my way up.

lines.zh: 墙塌了，我从灰里挣出来。
lines.en: The wall caves; I claw my way out of the dust.

lines.zh: 箭插进我的肩甲，卡住了。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my pauldron.

lines.zh: 那股力压住我的剑，抬不起来。
lines.en: That force bears down on my blade.

lines.zh: 饿了两天，我的脚步发虚。
lines.en: Two days without food and my steps are weak.

lines.zh: 雷打在近处，我半边身子都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes close and half my body goes numb.
There's nothing solid underfoot.
